title: CrossQ: Task-Aligned Cross-Token Conditional Quantization for Late Interaction Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.19204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Late-interaction retrievers like ColBERT achieve high quality but suffer from large multi-vector indices. Standard compression minimizes token reconstruction error, while ranking depends critically on preserving scores of sparse "winner" tokens. We introduce CrossQ, which adaptively improves effective token fidelity within documents by conditioning token codes on lightweight document context computed at indexing time (but not stored). CrossQ is trained with ranking-aligned objectives that preserve candidate score distributions and protect hard-negative margins. At 2 B/token, CrossQ improves MRR@10 by +0.010 over the strongest strictly footprint-matched quantization baseline and by +0.012 over the strongest candidate-matched system reference. On a nine-dataset BEIR subset, CrossQ improves average nDCG@10 by +0.009 at 4 B/token over the strongest candidate-matched system reference. At 4 B/token, CrossQ achieves 64x raw token-storage reduct

translated_title: CrossQ：面向晚期交互检索的任务对齐跨令牌条件量化
translated_abstract: 晚期交互检索器如ColBERT虽然质量高，但多向量索引开销大。标准压缩方法最小化令牌重建误差，而排序性能关键取决于保留稀疏“胜出”令牌的分数。我们提出CrossQ，通过在索引时计算（但不存储）轻量级文档上下文，对令牌编码进行条件化，自适应提高文档内的有效令牌保真度。CrossQ使用与排序对齐的目标进行训练，保留候选分数分布并保护难负样本的间隔。在2 B/token下，CrossQ在MRR@10上比最强严格足迹匹配量化基线提高+0.010，比最强候选匹配系统参考提高+0.012。在九个数据集的BEIR子集上，CrossQ在4 B/token下比最强候选匹配系统参考平均nDCG@10提高+0.009。在4 B/token下，CrossQ实现64倍原始令牌存储缩减。
tldr: CrossQ通过索引时轻量级文档上下文条件化令牌编码，结合排序对齐训练目标，在极低比特率下显著提升晚期交互检索的排序质量，同时大幅压缩索引存储。
en_tdlr: CrossQ conditions token codes on lightweight indexing-time document context with ranking-aligned objectives, significantly improving late-interaction retrieval quality at ultra-low bitrates while drastically compressing index storage.
